name: slopocop-design
description: Slop cop for design — stops UI from looking AI-generated. The design counterpart to slopocop (text). Ships hallmark (anti-AI-slop design engine: 58-gate slop-test, 21 macrostructures, 50 components, audit/redesign/study) plus two taste skills (frontend-design by Anthropic, design-taste-frontend), two commands (/design-audit ranked slop findings with no edits, /design-redesign a fresh visual take that preserves routes/copy/logic), and an on-demand design-cop reviewer agent. No hook by design — laws-of-ux already nudges on frontend edits. Use when building or redesigning a page, or auditing UI for templated slop. Text slop lives in slopocop.
